title: Fault Atlas — form record
description: One observed form of fault in a knowledge graph built from documents. The file is the record of truth: it must be readable and judgeable without any software.

legacy_line.description: Line number in the catalogue of 2026-08-09 (korela.db), for traceability.

name_fr.description: Original French name, verbatim from the source catalogue.

damage.description: What the form does to the graph. MERGE: two real things become one node. SPLIT: one thing becomes several nodes. SPURIOUS_EDGE: a relation that the source never asserted. MISSING: a node or relation that the source asserts and the graph lacks. WRONG_VALUE: a property, number or date is wrong. WRONG_LABEL: an entity or relation type is wrong. ANACHRONISM: a fact is placed outside its validity interval, or a superseded status is kept. CORPUS_PARAMETER: not a damage; a property of the corpus composition.

class.description: DEFEATED: cancelled by deterministic code, no judgement of meaning, with a test. DEFEATED_IF_XML: cancelled when the source is structured (JATS/XML), not on composed PDF. REFUSABLE: code can either handle it or explicitly abstain; never produces a false. SILENT_FALSE: the error yields a plausible result that code cannot detect from inside. IRREDUCIBLE: requires meaning; no code cancels it.

layer.description: Layer of the product stack where the form bites (korela_base 00b numbering kept as text).

injection.description: How the form is fabricated into a document for a controlled corpus. IMAGE requires rendering and vision, not text injection. DESIGN: decided in the truth (world specification), not injected. CONSTRAINT: a schema rule.

legacy_severity.description: G1..G4 of the 2026-08 catalogue. House vocabulary, kept for traceability only; not a measure.

legacy_mechanism.description: M1..M12 remedy family of the 2026-08 catalogue. Traceability only.

observed_absent_in.description: Corpora where the form was searched for and measured absent (a result, not a gap).

seen.description: Where the form was observed. Empty array = no specimen yet; the form is then a hypothesis, not an observation.

excerpt_en.description: English translation of the excerpt when the original is not in English. The original stays the record; the translation is a courtesy.

organisation.description: Organisation of the observer, when different from the form's origin.

corpus_id.description: Identifier of a corpus record in corpora/, when the observation was made on a published, reproducible list.

counter_examples.description: What a remedy must NOT touch. A form with cases and no counter-example cannot be tested.

refusal_clause.description: When the code cannot conclude, what it returns instead of guessing.

needs.description: External registries or identifiers required (Crossref, ORCID, trial registries...).

guard_effect.description: Measured effect of the guard that holds this form, by outcome only. Never the mechanism.

reachable_by_deletion.description: Can a deletion-only repair (nodes, edges, labels) restore the truth for this form?

judgeable_by.description: Which kind of truth can judge this form. Empty = no known truth judges it yet.

organisation.description: Organisation that contributed the form (e.g. 'Loxyn SAS, Lyon' or 'LIRIS, CNRS/Lyon 1').

campaign.description: Observation campaign or project the form comes from.

contact.description: Public contact of the contributing organisation.
